en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘The tooth, when it is stuck, would be awaited with for a year. So if it falls off, the striker would be fined five hundred Dirhams, and if it does not fall off and blackens, he would be fined two-thirds of its wergild’.
